notes:
CRM notes (fragments):
- Large global fintech that does realtime transaction scoring + customer support chat.
- Primary ask: Dedicated GPU pools with hard throughput guarantees and firm latency SLOs (p50/p95).
- Target workload: mix of low-latency chat (user-facing, target p95 <= 150ms token-level for 4k context on trimmed model variants) and high-throughput reranking/embeddings for fraud pipelines (target 1.5k-2.5k requests/sec aggregate across regions).
- Model preferences: prefer open weights for cost control; baseline: Llama2-70b-quantized (primary), 13B as fallback for latency-critical flows. Will accept quantized INT8/4 paths.
- Routing/fallback: need cross-region failover policy + automatic fallback to smaller model family under heavy load. Must preserve consistency for session affinity for chat (KV cache warmup cost concerns).
- Capacity ask: initial reserved pool request: 32 x A100-ish equivalent in us-east, 24 in us-west, 16 in eu-west with 25-30% failover headroom. Want plan for cold-standby vs hot-standby tradeoffs.
- Failover SLAs: target total failover recovery < 90s for session continuity (best-effort); product wants explicit headroom math (how many GPUs required to sustain 99th percentile traffic for 30m window).
- Autoscaling: willing to allow burst to shared capacity but wants clear billing delta + cap on burst percentage.
- Observability: token-level cost breakdown, per-route latency heatmaps, tracing hooks for tail latency analysis required.
- Compliance: EU data residency for EU customers, HSM/KMS integration required for key material. SOC2 + ISO27001 required by vendor list.
- Quote from CTO (paraphrase): "Latency is non-negotiable for revenue-facing flows — we need deterministic tail behavior, not averages."
- Internal stakeholders: CTO (Suresh Patel), Head of Platform (Ana Gomez), Head of Procurement (L. Brown).
- Linked artifacts: security FAQ (drive), latency profiling spreadsheet (drive/latency/ironwood-q1), initial SOW draft (drive/sow/ironwood-dedicated-v1.pdf).
- Decision horizon: end of Q2 2026, dependent on procurement + legal SLA clause for data residency.
- Notes style: short bullets, action items prefixed with owner initials in meeting notes.
